_doc: Watermark for the daily SDK-delta watch routine (see CLAUDE.md § Reference implementations). The routine clones each ref, runs `git log <last_seen>..HEAD` over the critical paths, triages new commits for parity gaps vs our Elixir lib, files/updates rmap tasks, then advances last_seen to the new HEAD. Seeded 2026-06-24 at the HEADs whose deltas were already triaged by hand (mpp-rs #299 -> Task 65; mppx #577 -> Task 46), so the first run reports only genuinely newer commits.
